title: Lepak DAO
tagline: Building an End-End on chain community for builders in South East Asia
description:
We have witnessed increasing awareness of blockchain and many young builders rising up in our local community, that's why we have decided to launch Lepak DAO, aiming to be the first fully on-chain builder family in South East Asia. We are planning to launch our very first IRL hacker house in Kuala Lumpur. It is an END-TO-END ROBUST application that provides our users different functionalities : Long Term Hacker Houses ( LTHH ) ,Decentralized Storage of Information ,Decentralized Video Streaming ( workshops ) with integrated decentralized messaging system, Notifications services, Proof Of Humanity and Uniqueness, Privacy in voting rounds ( using ZK Badges )
and many more.
how_its_made: We built this project using the following sponsors : Worldcoin & AutProtocol help us empower our DAO with proof of humanity and extending it using roles + giving us the option to use aut-id features on our dashboard. Livepeer, & XMTP allow us to have a platform where users can do livestreams, either is a workshop or a meetup online, all decentralized, XMTP give the option for those livestreams to have a decentralized messaging box, for everyone to give comments and feedback on the livestream. Users are also able to send some tokens to the person who is streaming as a way of rewarding. Tellor gives us the power to make our NFTs dynamic and allowing our protocol to support payments in different Coins. IPFS takes our users' info and puts it on-chain, accessible anywhere, open to the community. EPNS helps us to establish a notification system on our APP, for example when a user has joined, or when a streamer has received funds, or when the treasury performed an investment transaction, we perform Investment into AAVE pools by supplying assets. Then Sismo brings privacy into voting rounds on our app, when users of the DAO want to stay anonymous on their voting, they will use zk-badges from sismo to perform an anonymous vote. Finally , our project is deployed to Polygon and Skale.
